notes.text: Assumes new SemaphoreSlim(1) without an explicit maximum uses int.MaxValue as maxCount, so an extra Release silently raises the count to 2 instead of throwing. This matches the documented constructor behaviour as I recall it but was not re-checked against the page.

Traced output, not run: the original snippet prints 'busy, skipped' and then dies with System.Threading.SemaphoreFullException at the outer Release (line 22). The fixed snippet prints 'busy, skipped' then '1'. Needs run-snippets confirmation.
The local function Save is called recursively and captures the top-level locals gate and saved; I expect this to compile under the statements harness, but it is not verified by a build.
